description: Call this FIRST before any other tool for this provider. Login to COMWEL via NPKI AnySign certificate. Works only when business_registration_no maps to exactly one COMWEL business management number; with two or more the login fails and no input of this tool picks one. For an authenticated call, generate and save request_idempotency_key before the first request. Reuse it with the same arguments only to recover that request after a lost response; use a new key for a new execution. Without it, calling again remains a new request. This optional key is not available to anonymous taste calls. Keep any provider-specific idempotency_key unchanged; it is a different field. 호출마다 토큰 1소진

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

request_idempotency_key.description: Optional same-request recovery key for authenticated calls; see the tool description.
